# variants, applied to the cells with x_HI < 0.01 only: own; uG: x_HI * Gamma/Gamma_ref; uT: x_HI * (T/T_ref)^0.7 and T -> T_ref; uGT: both. Gamma_ref, T_ref: the medians of those cells; ion: uGT, and the other cells get T_ref and the equilibrium n_HI ~ rho^2 at Gamma_ref, T_ref (no neutral gas)
